summary: End-to-end verification of Celesta Glow marketplace feature set (location, pricing v2, prepaid consult, admin sidebars/managers, doctor & partner portals, consult room, my bookings). Backend pytest suite: 15/15 passed. Frontend: all required data-testids present and critical flows working on https://celest-replica.preview.emergentagent.com.

issues: Non-blocking React console warnings on homepage/doctors: duplicate list keys ('Encountered two children with the same key'), UNSAFE_componentWillMount in strict mode (from carousel dep), 'fetchpriority' DOM prop casing. No functional impact but should be cleaned up.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py still ~3900 lines; incremental extraction to /routes continues (mp_core, mp_ops, geo, customer_auth) — recommend finishing modularization.
React 'duplicate key' warnings persist from previous iteration — product/category lists need unique .map keys.

AdminDesktopSidebar is intentionally hidden on /admin/dashboard & a few other OWN_SIDEBAR routes; dashboard uses its own nav. If product requirement is 'sidebar on all admin pages', add dashboard to the sidebar as well (currently relies on dashboard-level cards).
test_credentials: Admin: celestaglow2024 (OK). Doctor OTP via /api/mp/auth/send-otp returns dev_otp. Customer OTP via /api/auth/send-otp; code in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log (grep 'OTP:'). Sample doctor dr.meera@sample.celestaglow.com, partner partner.test@sample.celestaglow.com, customer t@x.com.
seed_data_creation: None added. Used existing seeded doctor/partner/customer and existing paid+completed consult CG-C-C8C38167D602.

verified_features.location_gate_and_modal: On /doctors without saved location shows location-gate + enable-location-btn + search-location-btn. With cg_delivery_location set, /doctors loads doctor-list with 3 doctor cards (no gate). Header location-strip-change opens location-modal with detect-location-btn, location-search-input, quick-areas all present.
verified_features.homepage_gold_badges: gold-badge-doctor and gold-badge-service rendered on homepage.
verified_features.three_col_grids: service-list gridTemplateColumns='397 397 397' (3 cols), doctor-list '355 355 355' (3 cols) at 1920 viewport. 9 service-card + 9 discount-badge + 9 price-tag; 3 doctor-card + 3 price-tag + 3 discount-badge.
verified_features.service_detail: service-price-box + pro-picker present. document.body does NOT contain 'platform fee' text (case-insensitive). Bridal Glow Package visible in /api/mp/services (approved live).
verified_features.doctor_profile: price-tag + discount-badge render. No 'Platform fee' text.
verified_features.prepaid_only_consult: POST /api/mp/consultations/instant -> 503 'Instant consultations need online payment, which is being set up' when Razorpay not configured.
verified_features.admin_sidebar_and_managers: /admin/dermatologists, /admin/partners, /admin/media-tools all show admin-desktop-sidebar with featured sidebar-dermatologists and sidebar-partners. /admin/dashboard shows nav-dermatologist-manager and nav-partner-manager cards (dashboard uses its own sidebar by design).
verified_features.admin_guard: Unauthenticated navigation to /admin/partners lands on /admin with password input visible.
verified_features.derm_manager: 3 crm-contact-<id> rows with mobile+email. Settings tab shows pricing-settings with input-platform_commission_pct, input-customer_fee_pct, input-display_markup_pct, save-pricing button, pricing-preview.
verified_features.partner_hub: phub-custom tab present (Awaiting review / Live / Rejected / All filters).
verified_features.pricing_math_customer_visible: Doctor fee for Dr. Meera: base 799 -> customer 919, mrp 1195, discount 23% -- matches review spec. my/bookings shows '₹919' for CG-C-C8C38167D602.
verified_features.doctor_portal: After OTP login (dev_otp works), Wallet tab reveals wallet-balance + wallet-info-btn; clicking info toggles wallet-breakdown.
verified_features.partner_portal: Services tab shows my-svc-price-* editable inputs for owned services (2 approved: Classic Clean-Up, Bridal Glow Package) with 'You earn ₹X after 15% Celesta commission' hint. toggle-custom-form present; +New service reveals custom-name/custom-price/custom-image/custom-submit.
verified_features.consult_room: /consult-room/CG-C-C8C38167D602 as doctor renders Jitsi-ready join-call ('Start call') for completed/paid consult. 'Email completion code to customer' + 'Verify & complete' flow visible.
verified_features.my_bookings: Customer login via /api/auth/send-otp + verify-otp yields token stored in cg_auth_token. /my/bookings renders consult-<id> and consult-summary-<id> rows; completed consult shows '₹919 • CG-C-C8C38167D602 • completed'.
verified_features.geo_osm_fallback: GET /api/geo/reverse-geocode?lat=12.97&lng=77.59 returns 200 with city/locality (OSM fallback works when Google key absent).
verified_features.backend_price_view_no_commission_leak: /api/mp/services and /api/mp/doctors expose price/fee + mrp + discount_pct; no 'commission' or 'price_range' keys in public response.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All review-request flows are verified. Backend regression test lives at /app/backend/tests/test_celesta_glow_iter2.py (uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Remember: Razorpay/SMTP/Zoom are intentionally unconfigured — endpoints return 503 and OTPs land in backend.err.log. For customer OTP login UI storage key is 'cg_auth_token'; for doctor it's 'mp_doctor_token'; for partner 'mp_partner_token'; admin uses sessionStorage/localStorage 'adminToken'. React console still emits legacy warnings (duplicate keys, UNSAFE_componentWillMount, fetchpriority) that main agent should clean up in a future pass but they're non-blocking.
